chunks.title: Who is Rohit
chunks.text: Rohit Kumar is a Backend Engineer based in Noida, India, focused on Node.js, TypeScript, and distributed systems. He has 3 years of experience building and scaling production backend services for AI voice and messaging platforms.

chunks.title: Current role
chunks.text: Rohit currently works as a Software Development Engineer II at SaaS Labs, on the JustCall AIVA (AI Voice Agent) platform. He has been a core engineer on AIVA from its launch through scaling to over 7,000 customers.

chunks.title: What Rohit owns
chunks.text: Rohit has end-to-end ownership across live-call orchestration, event-driven pipelines, caching infrastructure, and incident response for AIVA, JustCall's AI voice agent product.

chunks.title: Contact
chunks.text: You can reach Rohit Kumar by email at rohitk61299@gmail.com, on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/rohit-kumar-2a628013a, or on GitHub at github.com/rohitkr06.

chunks.title: SDE II at SaaS Labs
chunks.text: Rohit has been a Software Development Engineer II at SaaS Labs (JustCall / AIVA) in Noida, India since April 2025, and continues in this role today.

chunks.title: Enterprise Action Framework
chunks.text: As SDE II, Rohit designed the Enterprise Action Framework: a three-stage orchestration framework with pre-call context injection, in-call tools for SMS, calendar booking, and live-agent transfer, and post-call data extraction. This framework was tied to an enterprise deal worth $1.1M in annual recurring revenue (ARR).

chunks.title: Live Call Orchestration
chunks.text: Rohit built and scaled AIVA's backend live-call orchestration from launch to more than 7,000 customers, supporting roughly 5,000 AI voice calls per day. The system integrates with Retell AI, OpenAI, Twilio, and Deepgram.

chunks.title: Event-Driven Post-Call Pipeline
chunks.text: Rohit architected a fault-isolated, event-driven post-call processing pipeline using GCP Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks. Incoming webhooks are acknowledged only after the event is published, and the actual processing happens asynchronously with automatic retries.

chunks.title: Configuration Caching
chunks.text: Rohit added Redis caching with a 30-minute TTL for voice-agent configuration data. This eliminated about 6 redundant MongoDB reads per incoming webhook and cut overall database load by roughly 60%.

chunks.title: Kubernetes Efficiency
chunks.text: Rohit right-sized Kubernetes pod memory allocation by 33% and fixed misconfigured Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) targets. This let the cluster scale from 3 to 7-8 replicas at peak load, eliminated pod restarts, and cut the cluster's overall memory footprint by about 33%.

chunks.title: Reliability and Observability
chunks.text: Rohit instrumented latency and cost telemetry for the LLM, ASR (speech-to-text), and TTS (text-to-speech) pipeline stages using Langfuse, Grafana, New Relic, and Sentry. He uses LaunchDarkly for feature-flagged rollouts and serves as a first responder on PagerDuty for production incidents.

chunks.title: SDE I at SaaS Labs
chunks.text: Before becoming SDE II, Rohit was a Software Development Engineer I at SaaS Labs (JustCall) in Noida, India, from July 2023 to March 2025.

chunks.title: Zero-Downtime Database Migration
chunks.text: As SDE I, Rohit led a zero-downtime migration of MySQL from version 5.x to MySQL 8 across more than 100 million rows (120GB+ of data), improving SMS throughput by up to 10x.

chunks.title: SMS Campaign Moderation
chunks.text: Rohit built an automated moderation system that blocks policy-violating SMS campaigns before they are sent, cutting the manual review workload for the team by approximately 90%.

chunks.title: AI Agent Provisioning
chunks.text: Rohit designed AIVA's initial self-serve provisioning backend from scratch, covering AI agent creation, configuration, multi-tenant isolation, and full lifecycle management.

chunks.title: Platform Modernization
chunks.text: Rohit migrated legacy PHP SMS APIs to TypeScript and NestJS with TypeORM, cutting p99 latency from around 2 seconds to under 800 milliseconds, and deployed the new services on Kubernetes for zero-downtime releases.

chunks.title: Programming languages
chunks.text: Rohit's programming languages include TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and C++.

chunks.title: Backend and APIs
chunks.text: Rohit's backend and API skills include Node.js, NestJS, REST API design, microservices architecture, TypeORM, and Sequelize.

chunks.title: Databases and caching
chunks.text: Rohit works with MySQL, MongoDB, Redis for caching, and BigQuery for analytics.

chunks.title: Cloud and infrastructure
chunks.text: Rohit's cloud and infrastructure skills include Google Cloud Platform (GCP Pub/Sub and Cloud Tasks), Kubernetes, Docker, and LaunchDarkly for feature flags.

chunks.title: AI and voice technologies
chunks.text: Rohit has hands-on experience with OpenAI, Retell AI, Twilio, Deepgram, Langfuse, and prompt engineering for building AI voice agent products.

chunks.title: Observability tooling
chunks.text: Rohit's observability toolkit includes Grafana, New Relic, Sentry, PagerDuty, and distributed tracing.

chunks.title: Architecture and system design
chunks.text: Rohit specializes in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, system design, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

chunks.title: Education
chunks.text: Rohit holds a B.Tech in Information Technology from Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi, completed between 2019 and 2023 with a CGPA of 9.05 out of 10.

chunks.title: Lab Legend Award
chunks.text: In February 2026, Rohit received the Lab Legend Award at SaaS Labs, ranking in the top 12 of 70 engineers company-wide in recognition of his engineering ownership.

chunks.title: Customer Retention Award
chunks.text: Rohit received a Customer Retention Award at SaaS Labs for rebuilding voice-agent prompts and call flows that saved an at-risk enterprise account.

chunks.title: Impact in numbers
chunks.text: Highlights of Rohit's measurable impact: scaled AIVA to 7,000+ customers and ~5,000 AI voice calls per day; his Enterprise Action Framework was tied to a $1.1M ARR deal; he migrated 100M+ database rows with zero downtime, improving throughput up to 10x; automated moderation cut manual review by ~90%; Redis caching cut database load by ~60%; and Kubernetes right-sizing cut memory footprint by ~33%.

chunks.title: Career trajectory
chunks.text: Rohit joined SaaS Labs (JustCall) in July 2023 as a Software Development Engineer I and was promoted to Software Development Engineer II in April 2025, growing from building AIVA's initial provisioning backend to owning enterprise-scale live-call orchestration.
